claims.author: Zach Berman
claims.text: Head coach Nick Sirianni expressed hope Monday that Smith (hamstring) will return for this Sunday's game against the Panthers, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Zach Berman
claims.text: Head coach Nick Sirianni said Monday that he's "hopeful" that both Barkley (hamstring) and DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will both be cleared to play against the Panthers this coming Sunday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Adam Schefter
claims.text: Shipley (foot) was diagnosed with a partial tear of his plantar fascia after exiting Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars in London and could be sidelined multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

claims.author: Michael DiRocco
claims.text: Trotter was ejected from Sunday's game in London after receiving an unnecessary roughness penalty for fighting with the Jaguars' Bryan Thomas following the opening kickoff, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.

claims.author: Zach Berman
claims.text: The Eagles are expected to keep Johnson (personal) on the 53-man roster for the remainder of the season, even though he announced his retirement Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

claims.text: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Skowronek (calf) will not play against the Buccaneers this Sunday, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

claims.author: Mike DeFabo
claims.text: Steelers offensive coordinator Brian Angelichio said Monday that he anticipates Dowdle (toe) returning to action in Week 6 against the Buccaneers, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

claims.author: Brooke Pryor
claims.text: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he views Warren as "our featured player right now," Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

claims.text: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Samuel strained his right hamstring "pretty good" during Sunday's 32-29 win over Seattle and is "going to miss at least a couple weeks," David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

claims.author: Tom Pelissero
claims.text: Greenlaw was handed a one-game suspension without pay Monday for an act of unsportsmanlike conduct during Sunday's 32-29 win over the Seahawks, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
